from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class TestComponent(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name="value",is_list=False,required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  from hep_lfx import component
  value=self.value[0] if isinstance(self.value,list) else self.value
  return Data(data=await component("readTemplate",payload(value),self._id))

from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class TestComponent(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name="value",is_list=False,required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="preview",display_name="本地草案后停止",method="route_preview",group_outputs=True),Output(name="apply",display_name="进行一次模拟下发",method="route_apply",group_outputs=True)]
 def selected(self):
  selected=payload(self.value).get('stop')
  if selected not in ('preview','apply'):raise ValueError('stop only supports preview/apply')
  excluded=[name for name in ('preview','apply') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
 async def route_preview(self)->Data:
  self.selected()
  return self.value
 async def route_apply(self)->Data:
  self.selected()
  return self.value
